question: Speed of a boat in still water is 8 km/h and the speed of the stream is 2 km/h. A man rows to a place at 90 km and comes back to the starting point. What is the total time taken by him in the given two-way movement?
solution:

Speed of the boat in still water = 8 km/h

Speed of the stream = 2 km/h

Distance = 90 km
